tang-china.lineage_notes_sid: A cosmopolitan capital at the eastern end of the Silk Road, where monastic communities, merchant caravans, and farming villages meet along the Wei River valley.

peasant.description_sid: You work a small holding of rented land along the Wei River, its seasons setting the rhythm of every day.

merchant.description_sid: You move goods between the Western Market and the caravan depots, bargaining in three languages before noon.

monastic.description_sid: You live in the workshops of a monastery precinct, keeping the storehouses and greeting travelers at the gate.

about.disclaimer_body_sid: Yakshetra is a work of fiction inspired by Buddhist ethical and contemplative traditions. It does not represent itself as doctrine, nor as a teaching of any lineage, teacher, or school. The parami-inspired lenses, the cross-life echoes, and the narrative situations are game design choices made in good faith, not claims about how the world actually works. If a theme here is difficult for you, the content-warning settings let you step away from it.
about.lineage_body_sid: The game draws loosely on the six parami framework found across Theravada and Mahayana ethical literature, and on narrative conventions common to historical and fantasy fiction. No specific living teacher, order, or institution endorses or is represented by this work. Full lineage notes will accompany each era pack when the packs ship.

glossary.parami_definition_sid: A quality cultivated through practice. The game's six lenses are named for parami-inspired qualities.
glossary.lens_definition_sid: The frame a player focuses a choice through. Each lens is named for a parami-inspired quality.
glossary.intent_root_definition_sid: The root an action springs from: care, greed, aversion, or delusion. Drives the cross-life echoes.
glossary.karmic_echo_definition_sid: A narrative thread carried from one life into the next. Echoes add context and shift event availability; they are never a score.
glossary.bardo_definition_sid: An 'in-between' state. The game's between-lives screen is functional UI, not a depiction of any doctrinal bardo.
glossary.life_chain_definition_sid: A sequence of two lives the player moves through, beginning unburdened and closing on a chain-complete screen.
glossary.era_pack_definition_sid: A data pack defining one setting: its events, roles, glossary, and rule variation.
glossary.rule_variation_definition_sid: An era-specific social mechanic layered onto the engine without era-specific code branching.
glossary.narrative_seed_definition_sid: An event or beat injected into the next life by an echo, surfacing what carried forward.
glossary.content_warning_definition_sid: A category a player may toggle off to filter the corresponding events out of the pool.
glossary.social_identity_definition_sid: Opaque descriptive attributes of a life. Never aggregated into a score; never carried forward by echoes.

bibliography.entry_1_sid: Bodhi, Bhikkhu (trans.), A Comprehensive Manual of Abhidhamma — reference for the taxonomy of wholesome and unwholesome roots.
bibliography.entry_2_sid: Ñāṇamoli, Bhikkhu (trans.), The Path of Purification (Visuddhimagga) — reference for the parami framework.
bibliography.entry_3_sid: Web Accessibility Initiative, WCAG 2.2 — reference for the accessibility targets the UI is built toward.
bibliography.entry_4_sid: Expo Router documentation, https://docs.expo.dev/router — reference for the app's navigation model.
bibliography.entry_5_sid: Deque Systems, axe-core — reference for the automated accessibility audit rules.

death-of-self.description_sid: The player character's own death, referenced or depicted.

death-of-family.description_sid: The death of a family member or close relation.

illness-chronic-suffering.description_sid: Disease, injury, or sustained bodily suffering.

war-political-violence.description_sid: Armed conflict, occupation, or organized political violence.

betrayal.description_sid: A trusted person breaking a serious bond of trust.

social-oppression.description_sid: Coercive social hierarchies, caste, or institutional exclusion.

forced-moral-compromise.description_sid: Situations with no clean choice, where any path entails some harm.

separation-from-loved-ones.description_sid: Involuntary parting from family or close bonds.
